shots.prompt: One uninterrupted ten-second realistic travel shot of the exact original ordinary coast in <Picture 1>. Preserve the same empty stony and sandy shore, natural sea, distant coastal houses, roadside rail, utility poles, cloud patterns and subdued dusk light. Preserve the exact original tiny blue butterfly graphic in its lower-right corner; it is not a new animal and does not fly away or move around. Its two wings open and close extremely slowly and smoothly, approximately four seconds per complete cycle, with a peaceful almost-still rhythm and gentle pauses at the open and closed positions. No rapid flutter, vibration or flicker. The camera is completely steady. Only restrained natural waves move continuously. Keep the same exact object count and ordinary real-world colors; no scenic beautification, invented flowers, toys, magical light or new object. The scene is unoccupied by any person throughout. No person, body, hand, human face or facial fragment, silhouette or reflected person anywhere, including houses and road. No camera cut, new scene, zoom, readable text, title, subtitle, credits, speech, singing, humming, laughter or other voice. Keep the broad sky clean and unlettered for later typography.
